title: 第3737章 举全族之力辅佐第3736章 这谁接得住
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
小青龙呲牙：“采薇小妈，你不信我们能和萧无痕他们一战？”
“信你个鬼。”
“还有，我很严肃的警告你一句，别再叫我小妈！”
江采薇攥着双手，怒视着小青龙。
“小妈小妈。”
“我就叫，咋地？”
小青龙挑衅。
“小东西，今天不废了你，我江采薇三个字以后倒着写！”
江采薇怒喝。
小青龙脸色一变。
风紧，溜了！
“能管管它吗？”
看着消失在外面夜色中的江采薇和小青龙，端木雪满脸无奈地看着苏凡说道。
苏凡瘪着嘴：“我要是能管得了它，还会叫它逆子？”
“江采薇不但是我最好的朋友，还是名人堂排名第一的天才弟子，即将迈入五境中位神。”
“而且她喜欢的类型是那种英俊潇洒的美男子，所以你们以后少拿她开玩笑。”
为什么是排名第一？
因为名人堂，不会计算神子和神女的排名。
苏凡摸着下巴：“小爷不是美男子吗？”
端木雪黑着脸。

这混蛋，真的好欠揍。
“看来对于小爷是美男子这个事，雪妹子你是持有意见啊，只能说，你也不识货。”
苏凡一脸伤心的摇头叹气，转头看了下外面夜空：“我们来了这么久，陈老怎么也不来打个招呼？她是不欢迎我们吗？那我们走？”
端木雪摇头一笑：“人家陈老天天盼着你们来星辰殿，怎么可能不欢迎？她临时有事外出，黄泉试炼开启前，应该能赶回来。”
李有德问：“黄泉试炼开启的时间，应该是后天早上吧！”
“是的。”
“所以，趁明天还有时间，你们要去准备下，比如前往资源殿购买大量的神丹，前去神兵阁挑选一些强大的神器等等。”
说到这。
端木雪脸上爬起一丝笑意：“当然，你们也可以直接去找我师尊承天老祖和天衍老祖索要，毕竟你们脸皮比较厚。”
苏凡，李有德，小疯子，王小天相视，额头上齐刷刷爬起一排黑线。
当着他们的面，说他们脸皮厚？咋地，我们真不要面子？
content_en:
Xiao Qinglong bared his teeth: "Mama Caiwei, don't you believe we can fight Xiao Wuhen and the others?"
"Believe it or not."
"Also, I'm warning you very seriously, don't call me mommy again!"
Jiang Caiwei clenched her hands and glared at Xiao Qinglong.
"Little mom, little mom."
"I just called, what?"
Xiao Qinglong provoked.
"Little thing, I won't destroy you today. I, Jiang Caiwei, will write the next three words backwards!"
Jiang Caiwei shouted angrily.
Xiao Qinglong's expression changed.
The wind is tight, slip away!
"Can you take care of it?"
Looking at Jiang Caiwei and Xiao Qinglong disappearing into the night outside, Duanmuxue looked at Su Fan helplessly and said.
Su Fan pursed his lips: "If I could control it, would I still call it a traitor?"
"Jiang Caiwei is not only my best friend, but also the genius disciple ranked number one in the Hall of Fame. He is about to become a middle god in the Five Realms."
"And the type she likes is handsome and handsome men, so you should stop making fun of her in the future."
Why is it ranked number one?
Because the Hall of Fame will not calculate the ranking of the Sons of God and the Goddess.
Su Fan touched his chin: "Isn't I a handsome man?"
Duanmuxue had a dark face.
This bastard really deserves a beating.
"It seems that you, Miss Xue, have some opinions on the fact that I am a handsome man. I can only say that you don't know the difference either."
Su Fan shook his head and sighed with a sad face, then turned to look at the night sky outside: "We have been here for so long, why doesn't Mr. Chen come to say hello? Doesn't she welcome us? Then let's go?"
Duanmuxue shook her head and smiled: "Mr. Chen has been waiting for you to come to the Star Palace every day, how could he not welcome you? She is temporarily out of town for something, and she should be able to come back before the Underworld Trial starts."
Li Youde asked: "The time for the underworld trial to start should be the morning of the day after tomorrow!"
"Yes."
"So, while there is still time tomorrow, you should make preparations, such as going to the Resource Hall to buy a large number of divine pills, going to the Divine Weapon Pavilion to pick out some powerful artifacts, etc."
Speaking of which.
A smile appeared on Duanmuxue's face: "Of course, you can also go directly to my masters, Patriarch Chengtian and Patriarch Tianyan to ask for it. After all, you are quite thick-skinned."
Su Fan, Li Youde, Little Madman, and Wang Xiaotian looked at each other, and a row of black lines appeared on their foreheads.
Call them thick-skinned in front of them? Why, do we really have no face?
